reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute ticket volume roughly doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul 2026) to ~1180-1260/month (Aug-Sep 2026) (E-07) because a defect or change in the billing import/validation step around August is producing incorrect bills for the majority of accounts even when an ACTUAL meter read was accepted (E-04: 1785/3025 disputed bills were ACTUAL-read vs 1240 ESTIMATED), not because dispute handling is slow (E-02: response times within the 3.0-day SLA) or because tariffs changed (E-03: 0 tariff-change records).
reasoning_quality_informational.v2_root_problem: Billing dispute ticket volume roughly doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul 2026) to ~1180-1260/month (Aug-Sep 2026) (E-07) because billing import validation rule BV-17 — deployed 2026-08-01 with no unit scaling (E-13) — misreads firmware v4.2 meters' raw register values (reported in "0.1 m3" units vs plain "m3" for older firmware, E-14) as roughly 10x true consumption, causing the import step to reject these valid, timely-delivered AMI reads as REJECTED_HIGH_CONSUMPTION and substitute estimates, which accounts for 95.5% (1184/1240) of ESTIMATED-read disputes (E-12) — not field route-completion shortfalls (E-01, superseded by ER-1) or AMI/MDMS delivery failure (only 4.5% NO_READ_RECEIVED per E-12).
reasoning_quality_informational.ideal_final_problem: BV-17 validation rejects valid firmware-v4.2 AMI reads (unit-scale mismatch on H-MDMS-BILL) and substitutes estimates.
